answer: The tundra index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the ledge queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1143 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nebula. A farm of 68 pays that 218 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
